result.summary: Found 1 issue: in the 'Popular right now' section, two text strings in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar metadata line are drawn on top of each other. The rest of the page (header, search, category chips, promo banner, 'Fastest near you' carousel, bottom navigation) renders correctly.

issues.description: The metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows the delivery time ('25–35 min') and delivery fee ('€0 delivery') overlapping at the same position. The result reads as garbled text ('25–3€0mdielivery · Ramen'), making both the delivery time and the fee unreadable. The two elements appear to be absolutely positioned or missing a separator or spacing in the row layout.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the metadata items inline, for example in a flex row with a gap and a '·' separator, so the line reads '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen'. Check for absolute positioning or negative margins on these text nodes, and let the row wrap or truncate gracefully on narrow screens.
